ModMetaData.name: [CAP] RICS addon for Chat bots
ModMetaData.author: Captolamia
ModMetaData.description:
Optional addon for [CAP] Rimworld Interactive Chat Service (RICS).
Adds moderator-level bot-only commands that return structured gamestate data for an external AI chatbot (e.g. Masie). Responses are intended for the RICS AI command path (file/HTTP) — not for public viewer chat.
Commands: !botstate, !botpawns, !botthreats, !botmap, !botwealth, !botresources, !botgear (loadout + weapon stats), !botfaction, !botowned, !botdisown
When a letter, toast, death, or downed pawn is inside a room, the AI event includes that room name. Map ping sends the room under the cursor, or the outdoor area, as a colony event. Default key is F8. Change it in Options, Controls, RICS chatbot. A mouse button set there pings on a still click, so middle-mouse camera pan can stay free.
Requires RICS and Harmony. Load after RICS. DEV/Beta packageId: Captolamia.RICS.Beta | Release: Captolamia.RICS
GitHub: https://github.com/ekudram/cap-RICS-Chatbot-Addon License: AGPLv3
